summary: Completed frontend-only validation against the preview URL for Content Lab rebrand and interaction requirements. Core flows pass with no runtime errors.

integration_issues.issue: A floating external badge link ('Made with Emergent') is visible without a data-testid attribute. This appears platform-injected, not from portfolio component code.

action_items: No functional fixes required in portfolio sections for the requested scope.
If strict global data-testid compliance is required, hide or exclude the platform badge from test audits.
critical_code_review_comments: Data-testid naming prefixes can cause ambiguous prefix selector matches in automated tests (e.g., 'case-card-' also matches 'case-card-title-*'). Prefer stricter naming boundaries for long-term test maintainability.
App.css has a duplicated border declaration in .recruiter-panel (border: 1.5px then border: 2px); keep one declaration for clarity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on https://micro-moments-8.preview.emergentagent.com: hero branding, draggable stickers, sticky nav labels, proof board structure, 12 project cards, modal open/close with title/description/video, process icons with no old spiral/path/yellow-ball artifacts, footer artwork and links, and no desktop/mobile horizontal overflow.
rca of the issue: The only audit mismatch came from a non-product floating 'Made with Emergent' anchor rendered by environment overlay. Not reproduced in the inspected portfolio source components; likely injected outside app code.
